title: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M on gfx1151: the sampled (temperature > 0) MTP route is a measured serving loss at 5.3x a greedy cycle
purpose: Measure whether the sampled-acceptance MTP route, whose induced law is already exact, is a serving win for a real temperature request, against a true-AR control assigned per request inside the same load.
hardware: zbook, Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S (gfx1151)

tree.uncommitted_at_measurement: hipengine/models/qwen35.py: the production cap4 c1 evidence row's sampling_modes gains "sampled", which is the route's qualification switch. Reverted in the same unit as this artifact; shipped behavior for a temperature request is unchanged.
tree.note: the route needed three enabling repairs to reach a provider at all, all retained and all inert without the switch: the sampled prefill path never called observe_prefill_result, a packed prefill refuses logits and host hidden rows together (so a due sampled row must open the streamed target-hidden sink), and the recomputed accept summary was installed with dataclasses.replace, which broke the verifier's open-transaction identity.

server.command: python -m hipengine.server --model Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --served-model-name qwen3.8-27b-q4km --max-context-tokens 8192 --kv-storage bf16 --execution-profile production --speculative-mtp-serving auto --speculative-candidate-budget 3 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8087 --log-level info
server.debug_traces: off for these points: the measured run must not pay for stderr prints

workload.note: the same load serves the true-AR control in-run: --route-mix assigns the arm per request in submission order, so both arms see the same prompts, lengths, and server process.

c2_temperature_0.7.note: at c=2 the sampled rows mostly lose the route: 242 no_provider events against 244 autoregressive tokens, because the due group is width 2 and the admitted policy cell is the one-row (C1,K3) cell. The 7.07 tok/s is therefore a refused-route AR rate plus 12 MTP tokens, not a sampled-MTP rate.

c1_temperature_0.0_control.note: the same load and the same draft chain at temperature 0, where the accept rule is the retained argmax one: 1.66x, so neither the harness nor the host is the reason the sampled arm loses.

cost_model.acceptance_is_not_the_limit: the sampled arm accepted 89 and 87 drafts over 38 and 39 cycles, the same counts the greedy control accepted on the same prompts; coverage is 99.2% and 98.4%. The loss is the cycle's own cost.
cause: the sampled route cannot use the native target graph: the device-accept commit path (native_device_accept_commit) commits the argmax decision on device, so the adapter passes allow_graph=False and device_proposal=None for a sampled row, and every cycle runs the eager verifier instead of a graph replay

the accept decision is then computed on the host from full-vocabulary logits: the verifier returns one logits row per verified prefix (return_logits=True) and mtp_sampled_accept processes each row's own prefix distribution against the drafted chain in Python

correctness.distribution_gate: the induced law is exact: 824/824 induced-law comparisons (max total variation 4.5e-16, max KL 9.0e-16, top-1 agreement 1.0 against 1e-9) over supports up to 248,320 tokens, 144/144 autoregressive-law agreements, and a Monte-Carlo arm driving the real walk 4,000 times per config with no cell outside its calibrated limit. Artifact: results/2026-09-18-gfx1151-qwen38-mtp-sampled-accept-distribution-gate.json
correctness.identity_is_not_an_oracle_here: cross-arm token identity is not a quality gate for this route: the sampled accept walk consumes the row's sampler stream differently from the autoregressive path (acceptance draws plus a possible residual resample against one draw per token), so equal ids are not expected even though the induced law is equal. The law gate above is the correctness evidence; the greedy route's identity contract does not transfer.

decision.promotion: not promoted: the sampled route is a 2.1x decode loss and a 3.2x TTFT loss at c=1 temperature 0.7, with 99% of its output tokens coming from speculative cycles, so coverage cannot recover it
decision.switch: the evidence-row switch is reverted; the route stays closed and every temperature request keeps running autoregressive
decision.retained: the three enabling repairs are kept: they are correct on their own, inert without the switch, and each is pinned by a RED/GREEN test
decision.next_lever: a device-side sampled accept: the cycle cost is dominated by forfeiting the native target graph and by host-side full-vocabulary distribution processing. A kernel that computes the coupled acceptance from device logits and commits on device like the argmax path is what makes this route worth re-measuring; the arithmetic gate already fixes the target law.
